headline: REVIVAL GOLD NAILS 131.7m AT 3.43 g/t In Joss Zone, Idaho — 11.58 g/t Over 12.1m Kicker; Highest Grade-Thickness To Date At Beartrack-Arnett (TSX-V: RVG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Revival Gold Inc.
snippet: Revival Gold Inc. (TSX-V: RVG) reported August 4, 2026 that hole BT26-255D at the Joss area within its Beartrack-Arnett Project in Lemhi County, Idaho returned 131.7 metres grading 3.43 g/t Au — including 42.5 metres at 6.56 g/t Au and a 12.1-metre kicker at 11.58 g/t Au at 639 metres downhole — representing one of the highest grade-thickness intercepts in the project's drill history, with the zone of contiguous mineralization suggesting the beginning of a north-plunging high-grade shoot. This year's 5,500-metre program is targeting expansion of underground sulphide mineral resources last drilled in 2022, and the hole geometry is comparable to the prior BT21-240D result that defined the current mineral resource. For TSX-V gold investors watching permitted US development projects, Beartrack-Arnett sits in Idaho with a completed permitting process — a rare combination of grade, size, and jurisdictional certainty in the current gold market.

headline: TALON METALS 6.75% Ni AND 7.50% Cu IN 7.2m MASSIVE SULPHIDE At Tamarack — Fourth Level Confirmed; 300m Below Deepest Prior Intercept (TSX: TLO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Talon Metals Corp.
snippet: Talon Metals Corp. (TSX: TLO) reported August 4, 2026 that drill hole 25TK0568C at the Vault Zone within the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project in central Minnesota intersected 7.20 metres of Massive Sulphide and Mixed Massive Sulphides grading 6.75% Ni, 7.50% Cu, 0.07% Co, 4.89 g/t Pt+Pd, and 2.32 g/t Au — confirming a fourth mineralized level at the 802-metre depth and extending the Vault Zone system approximately 300 metres below the previously deepest known intercept. The stacked, vertically continuous architecture of the Vault Zone is consistent with a magmatic sulphide system capable of hosting a significant high-grade resource — and at grades averaging over 6% Ni and 7% Cu, each additional level confirmed substantially increases the potential mineral inventory of North America's most compelling domestic nickel-copper discovery. For critical minerals investors, Tamarack's US jurisdiction, proximity to existing infrastructure, and confirmed extension potential in a metal system that includes both EV-battery nickel and construction copper give this drill program rare dual-mandate appeal at a moment when Washington is funding domestic critical mineral supply chains.

headline: EAGLE NUCLEAR JOINS GLOBAL X URANIUM ETF — US$5B URA Fund Adds NUCL; Company Owns Largest US Conventional Measured Uranium Deposit (Nasdaq: NUCL)
snippet: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. (Nasdaq: NUCL) was added to the Solactive Global Uranium & Nuclear Components Total Return Index effective August 3, 2026 — qualifying it for inclusion in the Global X Uranium ETF (NYSE Arca: URA), one of the world's largest uranium-focused funds with over US$5 billion in net assets. Eagle Nuclear owns what it describes as the largest conventional measured and indicated uranium deposit in the United States, positioning the company as a domestic US uranium primary producer at a moment when the Biden-era prohibition on Russian uranium imports and the Trump administration's critical minerals executive orders have created unprecedented demand for US-sourced uranium supply. Inclusion in the Solactive Index is a watershed liquidity event for Eagle Nuclear: URA tracks the index mechanically, so the fund's approximately $5 billion in AUM must allocate to NUCL based on its index weight — introducing a structural institutional buying mandate that did not exist before August 3.

headline: CRITICAL ELEMENTS ROSE WEST LITHIUM ZONE TRIPLES TO 1,250m x 800m — 10,000m Drill Program Resumes After Wildfire; MRE Targeted Fall 2026 (TSX-V: CRE)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Critical Elements Lithium Corp.
snippet: Critical Elements Lithium Corp. (TSX-V: CRE) announced August 4, 2026 the resumption of its Phase 2 Summer 2026 exploration program at the 100% owned Rose West Discovery in Eeyou Istchee, Québec — a 10,000-metre systematic drill program temporarily suspended in early July due to proximity of forest fires to the camp, with all personnel now safely back and operations confirmed suitable to resume. Recent drilling has expanded the mineralized footprint from 450m x 370m to 1,250m x 800m — nearly tripling the surface expression of the lithium pegmatite system — with consistent widths of 10 to 40 metres of spodumene-bearing pegmatite and newly discovered zones 6 and 7 extending the system below current depths. With lithium carbonate prices up ~97% year-over-year at approximately CNY 85,000/tonne following CATL's Jianxiawo mine suspension in Sichuan, the window to advance a Canadian hard-rock lithium discovery of this scale toward a Fall 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate — in the Eeyou Istchee territory with community partnerships in place — is directly aligned with where institutional capital is rotating within the lithium development space.

headline: RUA GOLD CLEARS DRILLING AT GLAMORGAN — Adjacent To OceanaGold's 1.5Moz AT 17.3 g/t; 9,000m Program Launches Q4 In Hauraki Goldfield (TSX: RUA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Rua Gold Inc.
snippet: Rua Gold Inc. (TSX: RUA) announced August 4, 2026 it has received regulatory approval to commence exploration drilling at the Glamorgan Project, an epithermal gold target in the Hauraki Goldfield on New Zealand's North Island — 2.8 kilometres from OceanaGold's Wharekirauponga deposit, which hosts Indicated Mineral Resources of 1.5 million ounces at 17.3 g/t Au, one of the highest-grade undeveloped gold deposits in the Australasian Pacific. Surface exploration at Glamorgan has identified classic features of a major epithermal gold-silver system comparable to Wharekirauponga — a structurally consistent analogue located within the same mineralising corridor. A fully funded 9,000-metre initial drill program is planned across multiple targets, expected to commence Q4 2026. For junior gold investors, the Glamorgan approval is the permitting catalyst that converts years of surface exploration into drillable hypothesis: if the Wharekirauponga analogue holds at Glamorgan, the district-scale gold endowment of the Hauraki Goldfield — more than 15 million historical ounces produced — means discovery upside at Rua Gold is genuinely material relative to its current market capitalisation.

headline: OIL DROPS AND GOLD RISES: 'THE SAME FORCE THAT CRUSHED GOLD ALL YEAR JUST FLIPPED' — Iran Pause Cuts Inflation Risk, Softens Fed Hawkishness (GoldSilver.com)
snippet: GoldSilver.com published analysis in early August 2026 identifying a critical pivot in gold's price dynamics: the US pause on planned Iran airstrikes has caused oil prices to fall sharply, and lower oil is now a net positive for gold — the inversion of the dynamic that had pressured gold throughout H1 2026. The mechanism: for much of the year, gold bulls faced a brutal circular trap where US-Iran war risk drove oil prices up, which drove inflation expectations up, which reinforced the Fed's hawkish stance, which pushed real rates higher and compressed gold. The Iran pause breaks this chain — oil falls, measured inflation expectations moderate, the September Fed rate hike probability softens at the margin, and gold's $4,000 floor strengthens. The article argues this regime shift is underappreciated by markets still positioned for the previous oil-inflation-Fed tightening narrative — and that the setup entering NFP week is structurally different from any prior week this year.

headline: MONEY METALS: 'BULLION CAUGHT BETWEEN WAR AND THE FED' — 24% Drop From Jan Peak Sets Up Contrarian Case As NFP Week Begins
snippet: Money Metals Exchange published August 3, 2026 analysis framing gold's current position as a stand-off between two opposing structural forces: the US-Iran war risk that should be driving safe-haven demand higher, and the Federal Reserve's hawkish 9-3 vote that has reinforced real rate pressure on the metal. Gold has fallen approximately 24% from its January 2026 record above $5,598 to the current $4,060–$4,088 range — a drawdown that Money Metals argues is not a fundamentals-driven collapse but a policy-driven consolidation above the $4,000 floor that central bank accumulation has established as structural support. The piece is notable for its framing of Iran tensions as a double-edged sword for gold: while geopolitical conflict drives safe-haven demand, war-driven oil inflation simultaneously empowers Fed hawkishness that caps the upside. The analytical conclusion: gold's performance in August will be determined not by whether the war escalates or de-escalates, but by whether Friday's payrolls report forces a clean resolution to the Fed uncertainty — either a clear September hike or a clear hold.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD + ORLA MINING CLOSE C$26.3B DEAL — North America's New Senior Gold Producer; 1.1M oz/yr NOW, Path To 1.9M oz; 60%+ From Canadian Mines (TSX: EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) and Orla Mining completed their C$26.3 billion business combination on July 31, 2026 — creating North America's new senior gold producer with approximately 1.1 million ounces of annual gold production and a stated pathway to more than 1.9 million ounces as high-quality North American growth projects advance. More than 60% of production comes from three long-life Canadian mines (Greenstone, Valentine, and Orla's Camino Rojo in Mexico), with combined 2026 free cash flow projected at C$1.4 billion at current gold prices. Ross Beaty steps down as Chairman, with Chuck Jeannes appointed Chairman and CEO Jason Simpson to assume the Chief Executive Officer role from retiring Darren Hall effective October 31. For junior gold investors, the Equinox-Orla combination is the defining North American gold consolidation event of 2026 — creating a credible 1.1-to-1.9-million-ounce development story with the balance sheet, management depth, and Canadian-first asset base to become a natural acquirer of TSX-V development projects in the $500M–$2B enterprise value range.

headline: KINROSS Q2 RECORD FREE CASH FLOW $726M — Net Cash SURGES To $1.9B; 59% Earnings Growth At $4,483/oz Gold Realized; 40% FCF To Shareholders (TSX/NYSE: KGC)
snippet: Kinross Gold (TSX/NYSE: KGC) reported July 29, 2026 that Q2 2026 generated attributable free cash flow of $726.8 million — its highest quarterly FCF on record — as revenue rose 29% to $2.24 billion on a 37% increase in the average realized gold price to $4,483/oz, with net earnings advancing 59% to $844 million ($0.71/share). The balance sheet has transformed dramatically: Kinross has moved from $2.2 billion in net debt at year-end 2022 to a $1.9 billion net cash position at June 30, 2026 — the most rapid debt-to-cash pivot in the company's modern history — with the company on track to return 40% of its full-year free cash flow to shareholders. For mid-tier gold producers and TSX-V juniors, the Kinross Q2 print is the most relevant per-ounce cash flow benchmark in the mid-tier space: at $4,483/oz realized and $1,730 AISC, margin per ounce is $2,753 — a 42% year-on-year increase that benchmarks what well-managed mid-tier gold producers are currently generating, and sets the M&A value floor for quality development assets that Kinross, Agnico, and their peers could add through acquisition.
